scope.type: Read-only design fit/red-team, not independent replication or full ScenePilot paper audit
scope.source_of_architecture: User diagram as relayed by parent: hierarchical room/group/anchor RAG priors; LLM group planner; sequential Grow with group-local repair; final layout-specific VLM uses annotated topview+JSON+history and proposes move/rotate/scale.
scope.primary_paper_status: Parent separately reads exact paper/method/results; research agent checks official code. This sub-audit does not repeat full paper search.
scope.additional_parent_verified_fact: Parent reports abstract explicitly describes17k reverse trajectories and SFT+GRPO, so final specialized agent is not a training-free lightweight component. Exact runtime/training recipe/result values not independently inspected by this subagent.

fit_summary.user_task: Observed empty shell incl openings,height + complete furniture text inventory, no known dimensions/poses -> exact complete layout -> common RoomGenBench realization.
fit_summary.best_borrowable_piece: A planner can use room context plus optional train-only retrieval to assign every requested instance to one functional group and nominate anchors, then a deterministic verifier and bounded repair may correct geometry. First test this without specialized VLM training.
fit_summary.most_important_non_transfer: Do not import open-set inventory creation, unconstrained scaling, hidden GT support relations or cross-test retrieval. Current RoomGenBench exact-fit asset scaling changes which downstream size/shape risks exist.
fit_summary.minimal_candidate_workflow: One common planner call -> explicit per-ID group/anchor plan -> bounded geometric placement/repair -> independent global check -> optional one final general-VLM correction as an experiment. This is an ablation scaffold, not an assertion user new workflow is implemented or needs replacement.
fit_summary.novelty_status: Hierarchical grouping,RAG priors,local geometric repair,history-aware VLM corrections and SFT/RL editors already have close precedents. Borrowing components is reasonable engineering; novelty must come from a controlled result or a sharper task/method claim.

borrowable_modules.potential_use: Offer scale/spacing and functional grouping examples when text dimensions unknown; larger anchors give a useful coarse structure.
borrowable_modules.lightweight_form: Small offline cache of training examples/statistics, fixed top-k, no renderer or new asset generation.
borrowable_modules.uncertainty: Needs proof actual retrieval adds beyond generic LLM prior or per-class size statistics; retrieval can overconstrain novel inventory/rooms.

borrowable_modules.module: Group planner with stable instance IDs
borrowable_modules.potential_use: Reduce long inventory bookkeeping and expose anchor/dependent structure for many-object rooms.
borrowable_modules.lightweight_form: One structured plan partitions supplied IDs exactly once. Group is scheduling metadata; preserve full request IDs and count duplicates separately.
borrowable_modules.uncertainty: A semantic group is not automatically a physically independent packing component; wall/floor/ceiling supports can cross groups.

borrowable_modules.potential_use: Cheap geometry correction while group is small; deterministic checks can avoid repeated visual calls.
borrowable_modules.lightweight_form: Reuse one common repair operator and explicitly cap iterations/checks/moved IDs; validate against all previously placed groups.
borrowable_modules.uncertainty: Freezing earlier groups can create irrecoverable global packing/circulation traps; a timeout must remain failure/unknown.

borrowable_modules.potential_use: Can detect some semantic orientation,visual balance and crowded arrangement defects missed by coordinates alone.
borrowable_modules.lightweight_form: At most one optional call to an already-available VLM in a controlled ablation; no assumption specialized ScenePilot weights available.
borrowable_modules.uncertainty: Topview lacks support-height evidence; history increases context/cost; prompts and screenshots alone do not prove efficacy.

findings.observation: LLM grouping and sequential growth can omit/duplicate requested instances or add room-essential objects.
findings.impact: A better render or lower collision obtained with a different inventory does not solve user task.
findings.recommendation: Canonical request IDs; disjoint group partition whose union equals inventory; verify IDs after every Grow/repair/final edit. Optional additions reported separately and not accepted in primary output.
findings.minimum_check: Compare multiset/category counts and exact instance IDs, not category-set membership; retain all-scene failure denominator.

findings.kind: RAG leakage/design risk, not proven ScenePilot defect
findings.observation: Room,group and anchor caches could retrieve same house/scene or derived twins across train,test.
findings.impact: Retrieval can transmit reference placements/sizes/supports and inflate heldout performance.
findings.recommendation: Build cache only from training split; split by source+house/provenance group before extracting crops/groups/anchors. Deduplicate near-duplicate layouts across translation/rotation/reflection when appropriate. Freeze index and retrieval hyperparameters before final test.
findings.audit_artifacts: For each query log retrieved IDs,source,house,parent scene and split; hash cache manifest. Report same-source and unseen-source performance, overlap/near-duplicate audit and exact/near-neighbor exclusion ablation.
findings.boundary: Train-only reference layouts are legitimate learned information; using test/validation answers as retrieval exemplars is leakage. Known shell geometry and text are valid queries; hidden GTsupport or pose is not.

findings.observation: Sequential group packing may optimize each group while exhausting circulation space or blocking doors between groups.
findings.impact: Low pairwise collision can coexist with unusable whole-room layout. Largest connected free-areaNAV can also miss door disconnection.
findings.recommendation: Check global door-seeded reachability at declared agent width and furniture functional approach areas after each group; preserve openings and observed shell. Compare simple corridor/anchor reservations and limited backtracking against pure frozen Grow.
findings.minimum_check: Cross-group collisions,opening clearance,door-connected component,required approach areas and all-ID coverage; test reversed/random group orders and deliberately narrow rooms.
findings.boundary: Pairwise spacing or independent group bounds are not proof of door-to-object paths. Conservative lane reservations can also waste space; report success-quality tradeoff.

findings.observation: Final editor can scale objects; smaller boxes mechanically improve collisions/OOB/clearance.
findings.impact: The optimizer may turn a plausible sofa into an implausibly tiny object or cause severe asset deformation, while geometry metrics improve.
findings.recommendation: Because dimensions are unknown, do not globally forbid prediction. Instead use identical non-GT category/style size bounds and aspect-ratio rules for all methods, report every scale edit, and compare no-scale versus bounded-scale conditions. Track real dimensions and deformation; do not give GT sizes in main task.
findings.current_roomgen_caveat: Existing anisotropic bbox-fit can enforce any predicted dimensions and hide native asset size mismatch. Evaluate scale plausibility/deformation and support/function explicitly; confirm revised workflow before making a native-size-robustness claim.
findings.minimum_check: Per-ID log-scale change,aspect-ratio distortion,out-of-prior fraction,inventory success and blind scale plausibility; jointly report geometry gains and semantic/visual loss.

findings.observation: Annotated topview can reveal footprint overlap but not reliably floor/object support,height contacts,wall/ceiling mounting,or geometry inside an enclosingbbox.
findings.impact: A final VLM can move/scale a child or parent into a visually acceptable but unsupported/floating state.
findings.recommendation: Include structured z/height/support hypothesis and deterministic contact checks; at least an oblique view for a later visual experiment where needed. Infer supports from allowed inputs/meshes; do not feed GT support in primary test.
findings.minimum_check: Vertical gap,mesh contact or verified support surface,wall/ceiling mounting state; preserve support descendants during edits,report unknown contact rather than pass.
findings.boundary: BBox support approximation is a proxy and may fail on hollow/nonplanar surfaces. Extra views increase call/render budget and must be common across comparisons.

findings.observation: Diagram term reinforced or specialized agent alone cannot establish training details. Parent-confirmed abstract reports17k reverse trajectories,SFT+GRPO.
findings.impact: Training-free prompt baseline,trained layout agent and deterministic repair are different resource regimes; specialization could account for gains.
findings.recommendation: Separate inference workflow cost from offline trajectory generation,teacher/reward VLM,rendering andSFT/RL compute. Evaluate off-the-shelf same-budget editor and deterministic repair before considering training.
findings.minimum_check: LLM/VLM calls,tokens,prefill/history length,render count,repair/validator checks,p50/p95end-to-end latency; train data/teacher/model/hardware recorded when known.
findings.boundary: This subaudit gives no numeric training/runtime estimate for ScenePilot; paper figure or abstract cannot establish per-scene cost in user environment.

findings.observation: A specialized VLM may optimize the same cues/prompt family used by the evaluator,especially annotatedtopviews.
findings.impact: Improved VLM score may reflect evaluator alignment rather than independent geometry/function quality.
findings.recommendation: Hold independent geometry/contact/access checks and blinded quality evaluation separate; score final RoomGenBench realization with common cameras and schema. Do not treat two GPT scoring prompts as independent confirmation.
findings.minimum_check: Compare proxy improvements versus real-mesh failures and blind pair preferences; record unchanged/worsened cases,not just positive edits.

novelty_redteam.assessment: A useful structured retrieval engineering choice; hierarchy alone does not establish novel layout reasoning. Need true-vs-shuffled/no-retrieval controlled benefit on unseen sources and matched contexttokens.
Already close to Holodeck/LayoutVLM/RoboLayout local placement and VIGOR conflict-component repair; preserve-global-flow result would need direct evidence.

SceneReVis already learns iterative image+state diagnose/act usingSFT+GRPO and mandatory-object verification; Function2Scene and DirectLayout have check-and-refine/asset alignment. Newtraining labels or move/rotate/scale API alone not enough.

novelty_redteam.claim: Complete fixed inventory at low budget with jointsize/pose
novelty_redteam.assessment: Task-specific research opportunity only if same asset information,exact inventory,size plausibility,globalcirculation and budget constraints are enforced and a simple common-repair baseline is beaten. No global-first claim.

minimal_experiment.prerequisite: User supplies intended lightweight workflow. Freeze canonical input/output and common realization first; existing full-condition results cannot be relabeled as this protocol.
minimal_experiment.pilot: 30-50validation rooms stratified source,density; house/provenance groups separated. Reuse exact common GPTone-shot seed outputs and existing assets only where canonical protocol matches. No new paid calls/training authorized by this review.
minimal_experiment.why_this_2x2: Separates hierarchy benefit from extra retrieved prior information while holding repair common. Plan calls,tokens and retrievedcontext need matched caps; groupplanner should not quietly use moreLLMcalls.
minimal_experiment.final_editor_test: Take same D outputs; compare no finaledit,one deterministicextra repair budget,andone generalVLM edit with image+JSON. Replay edits on exactIDs. Specialized-trainedVLM only becomes separate later experiment if available; do not attribute its result to hierarchy/RAG.
essential_negative_controls: Replace retrieval with same-size shuffled/nonmatching trainingcontext to distinguish useful priors from extra tokens.
Try reverse/random grouporder on hardrooms to expose early-group lock-in.
Editor movement/rotation only versus boundedscale; report whether benefit survives removing shrinkage shortcut.
Globalchecks versus group-onlychecks; same final verifier for all methods.
primary_metrics: Door-seeded reachable functionalareas at declared agentwidth
Blinded layout/semanticquality on common realasset renders
minimal_experiment.statistics: Paired room-level outcomes with house/source clustering; multiple grouporders/seeds nested within room. Pilot is hypothesis-screening; final claims need untouched test and frozen thresholds.
falsification: Hierarchy/RAG gain vanishes at equalcall/token/context budget or after retrievedsamehouse/near-duplicate exclusion.
Uniform categorysizepriors or shuffledretrieval are as good as hierarchicalexamples.
Most editgain comes from invalidscales,missingIDs or using hiddenGTsupport.
Simple deterministicrepair on winningGPTinitialization matches specializedpipeline at lowercost.
FinalVLMjudge score improves while independentcontact/access/sizequality does not.

next_action: Inspect user lightweight workflow,then run only the lowest-cost matching ablation. Do not build full ScenePilot,collect17ktrajectories or startGRPO from this diagram.
